name: Motorcycle Simulator West Virginia
summary:
Ride Charleston, West Virginia, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

21 KM ROUND CHARLESTON
MacCorkle Avenue through Kanawha City past the University of Charleston, up and over the Kanawha River on I-64 into downtown past the Civic Center and Chase Tower, out along the river on I-64 / I-77 past the gold-domed State Capitol, then down the long Turnpike sweep and back over the water on the Yeager Bridge.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
